text:
```yaml
name: Regenerate Examples & Run Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Install just
        run: cargo install just

      - name: Install cargo-dup
        run: cargo install cargo-dup

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache Cargo git
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      - name: Build workspace
        run: cargo build --workspace --verbose

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --verbose

      - name: Run DB integration tests
        run: just test-db

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: just test-e2e

      - name: Run Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt -- --check

      - name: Check for duplicate code
        run: cargo dupes

      - name: Generate examples
        run: cargo run --bin generate-examples

      - name: Generate sandboxed examples
        run: cargo run --bin generate-examples-sandboxed
```
